techniques.example: Jin et al. 2022 survey; 'Call for Standardization' 2023; TSTBench 2025
techniques.origin: Text style transfer literature 2019-2025

techniques.name: Quiz/trap-item annotator screening
techniques.definition: Embed items with known gold answers in the annotation stream; drop raters who fail them; publish individual (pseudonymous) rater decisions to enable third-party bias audits.
techniques.example: Toxic Spans used quiz posts on Appen; Civil Comments released individual rater decisions (Borkan et al. 2019b)
techniques.origin: Jigsaw/Appen crowdsourcing practice

techniques.name: Balance-by-construction political sampling
techniques.definition: Build the political-register ham slice from legislative records carrying speaker-party metadata, stratified to equal representation per party/era, and report FP rates per party slice rather than in aggregate.
techniques.example: Congressional Record parsed speeches (Stanford, 43rd-114th Congresses, Gentzkow-Shapiro-Taddy) with party fields; Hansard under OPL-UK-3.0
techniques.origin: Congress-text econometrics literature

framework_implications: Adopt SpamAssassin's gate numbers as the starting CI contract, adapted per-slice: a pattern is promoted only if (a) it hits >= some minimum share of the attested-manipulative specimen corpus for its family, (b) S/O >= 0.95 overall, AND (c) FP < 1% within EVERY register slice and EVERY political-party/dialect slice separately — plus lint (pattern compiles, has required metadata) and a runtime budget; keep SA's explicit maintainer-vote override path so the gate is a default, not a constitution.

Ship a versioned 'ham-pack' as a first-class repo artifact with a lockfile of sources and licenses: Enron (workplace email; FERC public release), Congressional Record parsed speeches stratified equally by party + Europarl + Hansard OPL-UK-3.0 (political statements), WNC's 385k unchanged-neutral Wikipedia sentences + article-namespace samples CC BY-SA (encyclopedic/loaded-framing baseline), Civil Comments CC0 non-toxic majority (public comments), CORE for register diversity pending LICENSE.txt verification; explicitly document the exclusion of Pushshift Reddit and OpenSubtitles on license grounds so contributors don't re-add them.

Cover the un-licensable registers (personal messages, real workplace email beyond Enron's 2001 idiom) with federated mass-check: an opt-in local runner that executes the pattern pack over a user's own text and uploads only per-pattern hit counts + register tag, never content; aggregate these logs in the same RuleQA-style dashboard as the open ham-pack.

Structure annotation as two tiers with different agreement targets: Tier 1 crowd span-marking, 3-7 raters, character-majority aggregation, six parallel binary questions per span (one per family), target mean pairwise kappa >= 0.55 (Toxic Spans precedent) — block community launch of any family that pilots below 0.45; Tier 2 trained-annotator family adjudication with a named consolidator role, target post-consolidation gamma >= 0.6 (PTC precedent), and a gold format that stores disjunctive alternatives (MAFALDA) because families genuinely overlap.

Sequence the six families by known difficulty: launch community annotation first on hedging cues and deleted-agent/passive (lexico-syntactic, BioScope/CoNLL-2010 protocols exist, cue-level not scope-level marking), then loaded framing (highest frequency in PTC, WNC provides parallel training/eval data), and hold deflection, minimizing, and overclaim behind expert-only annotation until pilot IAA proves them — the 4-to-23-category precedent gradient (alpha 0.6 down to gamma 0.13) predicts these pragmatic families will not survive crowd annotation.

Store per-annotator marks (pseudonymous), adjudication provenance, and annotator-pool composition stats in the public dataset, following Civil Comments' release of individual rater decisions — this is what makes third-party bias audits (the Sap 2022 kind) possible and is itself an anti-capture mechanism for the lexicon's governance.

Build the truth-caption eval suite as a five-check CI harness that runs on every prompt/model change: (1) directional NLI, source-entails-rewrite and rewrite-entails-source, gate on minimum; (2) claim-strength ladder equality per claim (fine-tune on the CopeNLU exaggeration data + SPICED) — this is the check that specifically catches hedge deletion and evidential strengthening, which NLI alone misses; (3) QAFactEval-style QA over commitments; (4) SARI against a growing set of reference captions (start with 200-500 hand-written ones, biased toward minimal edits per the WNC finding); (5) quarterly human triad (meaning/register/fluency) with published Krippendorff alpha.

Encode the US Federal Plain Language Guidelines (public domain) as the truth-caption's operational target spec AND as machine-checkable lint over captions (identified actor present, active voice, verb-based, sentence length); cite ISO 24495-1:2023's four principles for legitimacy but never copy its text into the repo (paywalled ISO copyright); note the elegant reflexivity: a caption failing the 'identified actor' check has re-committed the deleted-agent pattern the detector flags.

Maintain a pinned template regression suite (Dixon-style) as a permanent CI job: the same proposition rendered across identity terms, AAVE vs SAE, and left/right political actors must produce identical marks; add dialect-priming language to annotator guidelines (Sap 2019) and record annotator political-leaning distribution (Sap 2022) so skew is measurable rather than invisible.

Data model requirements that fall out of all of the above: every corpus document carries {license, register, source, party/speaker metadata, dialect estimate}; every gold span carries {annotator set, tier, adjudication history, disjunctive alternatives}; every pattern carries {family, S/O history per slice, promotion status, vote record}; every truth-caption eval run carries {model/prompt version, five-check scores} — without these fields the gate cannot be computed per-slice and the audit trail collapses.
